criteria_frozen.partial_credit: 1 point for correct call chain without the metadata/reopen consequence, or correct consequence without the chain.

judging_commitments: Use rubric point values exactly: C1/C2/C3 0, 1, or 2; C4/C5/C6/C7 0 or 1.
Do not infer omitted answer content from generally good code understanding, source knowledge, or another answer.
Assess each anonymous answer independently before comparison; do not guess provenance or arm.
Citations must resolve to frozen repository-relative paths and line spans and support the associated causal claim; mere overlap or whole-file citation is insufficient.
Accept equivalent valid spans; do not require exact rubric ranges or evidence IDs.

Distinguish source reasoning and proposed regression from actual execution; no reproduction was run by this evaluator.

verified_evidence_spans.claim_supported: A writing block causes SegmentImpl::Open to recover it.
Recovery opens a local recover_wal_file and defers its close; it does not assign the member wal_file_.
Recovery dispatches records directly to internal insertion/update/upsert/delete methods.
Internal insertion creates/writes memory components and updates doc_ids_ and writing-block metadata.
Recovery finishes with Status::OK without attaching/reopening the member WAL.
Optimize switches a nonempty writing segment before planning compaction on persisted segments.
Segment switch dumps the old segment, removes its writing-forward-block metadata, installs new writing segment, and persists the new version.
dump calls flush before sealing; flush returns success immediately if member WAL is null or has no record.
The early return skips memory-store, scalar/FTS and vector-index flushes.
The normal flush finalizes memory components into persisted-block metadata and updates/flushed version.
Statistics count current segment objects and derive completeness from vector-indexed metadata.
Per-segment count is derived from in-memory doc_ids_, minus deletions.
Ordinary Insert calls append_wal before internal_insert.
open_wal_file installs wal_file_; append_wal opens it lazily before appending.
Successful finish_memory_components registers persisted scalar/vector blocks.
Existing pre-fix crash test verifies readback immediately after recovery but does not optimize and reopen.
